description: A provider class for managing transaction data in a Flutter application, including loading, adding, updating, and removing transactions, with external service integration.

classes.name: TransactionProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier managing a list of transactions, handling CRUD operations and state updates for a specific month.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads transactions for the selected month from the transaction service.

methods.name: setMonth
methods.description: Updates the currently selected month and reloads transactions.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new transaction and updates the internal list.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing transaction by ID.
